# Formino

> MIT-licensed, configuration-driven TypeScript form engine. Separate form definitions from React / Ant Design rendering; reuse the engine with local TypeScript or host-managed supported JSON and AI-generated configuration.

Repository: https://github.com/eugeneaiao-ui/formino
Package name: forminojs
Install: npm install forminojs
Release: 0.1.0
npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/forminojs
Core has no React or Ant Design imports. UI adapters support edit, preview, snapshot, validation, dependent fields, async options, and custom controls.

The host owns backend storage, definition publishing, data-source implementations and executable behavior. Configuration provides a bounded target for AI generation; no comparative AI-cost benchmark has been published.

## Start here

- [English overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eugeneaiao-ui/formino/main/README.en.md): configuration-driven philosophy, integration, installation and minimal example.
- [Chinese overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eugeneaiao-ui/formino/main/README.md): configuration-driven philosophy and documentation index.
- [AI and low-code integration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eugeneaiao-ui/formino/main/docs/AI_INTEGRATION.md): JSON generation, validation, renderer, limitations.
- [Configuration JSON Schema](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eugeneaiao-ui/formino/main/schemas/form-definition.schema.json): version 1 serializable configuration subset, not a schema for submitted values.
- [JSON example](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eugeneaiao-ui/formino/main/examples/ai/service-request.json): runnable service request form.

## Long forms and dependencies

- [Illustrated examples](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eugeneaiao-ui/formino/main/docs/EXAMPLES.md): 100/300/1000-field demo, asynchronous cascade, multi-stage calculations, dynamic attributes, conditional validation, snapshots.
- [Measured browser performance](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eugeneaiao-ui/formino/main/docs/PERFORMANCE.md): production-build measurements, environment, raw samples and reproducible scripts.
- Progressive mounting renders batches but retains the complete DOM afterwards. Full-form validation must wait until every field is registered.

## Reference

- [Configuration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eugeneaiao-ui/formino/main/docs/CONFIGURATION.md): template, fields, middleware, data sources and dependencies.
- [API](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eugeneaiao-ui/formino/main/docs/API.md): exported interfaces.

- [Quick start](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eugeneaiao-ui/formino/main/docs/GETTING_STARTED.md): complete typechecked example.
- [Example JSON adapter](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eugeneaiao-ui/formino/main/examples/ai/parse-definition.ts): Ajv validation plus field/source checks; example code, not a package export.

## Integration boundaries

- The JSON contract covers built-in controls and serializable properties only. It does not execute JavaScript, import components, or accept arbitrary API URLs.
- Host-approved data-source names may be referenced; application code owns network access and authorization.
- Advanced calculations, custom controls and renderers use the TypeScript API, registered by the host.
- The library is a form engine, not a complete visual drag-and-drop builder, LLM service, or general-purpose JSON Schema form renderer.
- llms.txt is a documentation index, not a search-indexing or AI-recommendation guarantee.

## Contribution workflow

External contributors fork the repository and open a PR to main from a short-lived branch. The maintainer reviews and squash-merges changes. Fork workflows require maintainer approval.

- [Contributing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eugeneaiao-ui/formino/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): fork, clone, branch, checks, push and PR instructions.
- [Branch and review policy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eugeneaiao-ui/formino/main/docs/CONTRIBUTION_WORKFLOW.md): protected refs, maintainer exception and current CI limitations.
